desc: Intermittent dockchannel-hid / MTP bring-up stall on the NVMe daily root: 2 of 11 boots (C2, C10 in linux-build-out/nvmeroot-20261025/runs/) stop right after 'RTKit: syslog message: kb_transport.c:271: IPD HIDSPI attached' at ~1.5 s with no interface configuration, no 'Keyboard ready', no input devices -> no keyboard and no trackpad that boot. Pre-userspace, so not init/firmware related. Offline first: compare the stalled vs good consoles line by line (RTKit messages, timing, any mailbox/IRQ errors), check the TRACKPAD_RESET_CONTRACT patch path and the 230 evidence for a known race, then propose a minimal driver-side retry/diagnostic. Evidence: evidence/2026-10-25-t6040-nvmeroot-trackpad-and-reboot.md.
author: claude
